title: She's Not There
feel: Tight, jazzy, staccato comping; half-time feel (Hooktheory counts 65); A Dorian

alt_voicings.label: Plain i
alt_voicings.note: Heartwood's chart writes Am; Am7 is Hooktheory's i7

sections.name: Verse
sections.bars: Am7 D | Am7 D | Am7 F | Am7 D | Am7 D | Am7 D | Am7 F | A

sections.name: Pre-chorus
sections.bars: D | Dm | Am7 Em | Am7 | D | Dm | C | E7
sections.note: Bar 3: Am7 and Em are short (one beat each in Heartwood's chart).

sections.name: Chorus
sections.bars: Am7 D | Am7 F | Am7 D | Am7 F | Am7 D | A | A

why: A **Dorian i7–IV vamp**, then switching between Dorian (D major) and Aeolian (Dm) inside one section, with a Picardy A major at cadences.
hard_change: **Pre-chorus D → Dm → Am7** at the half-bar: only the top-string finger moves for D → Dm.
theory: i7–IV (Dorian). The pre-chorus is IV → iv (Dorian → Aeolian), ending on V7 (E7). Cadences land on I-major (A).
steps: Changes alone, slowly: Am7 ↔ D, then D → Dm → Am7.
With the rhythm at 70% (about 90 bpm), staccato.
